name: ajiro-api

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Statically analyse the backend source and create/update the per-endpoint YAML files in api/. Run it after adding, removing or changing routes. Only `request` and `source` are managed by scan; `tests`, `mock`, summaries you wrote are preserved. Returns created/updated/unchanged counts, the list of endpoints with their YAML files and source locations, and `stale` files whose route no longer exists (never deleted automatically). Use dry_run to preview.

framework.description: Force a framework instead of auto-detection: nextjs, hono, fastapi, express, go-nethttp, go-chi, go-echo.

paths.description: Directories or files to scan, relative to the project root (default: `sources` in ajiro-api.yaml).

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing files.

tools.name: test
tools.description: Run the requests defined in the endpoint YAML files against the running API and check the responses. Returns a report: summary counts and one result per test; each failure has `check`, `path`, `expected`, `actual`, a one-line `message`, and the handler `source` (file:line) so you can jump to the code. The server under test must already be running at the environment's base_url. A failing test is reported in the result (ok=false), not as a tool error.

filter.description: Only run endpoints/tests whose id, file or test name contains this text, e.g. `users.create`.

update_snapshots.description: Overwrite stored snapshots with the actual responses. Only use when the new behaviour is intended.

base_url.description: Override the environment base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080.

smoke_unsafe.description: Also send the implicit smoke request to endpoints without tests whose method may change data (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE). Off by default; do not enable against shared or production environments.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List all endpoints defined in the api/ directory: id, method, path, YAML file, number of tests, source location and summary. Also reports files that failed to load. Use it to find the id to pass to get_endpoint or test.filter.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Validate all endpoint YAML files without calling the API: YAML syntax, schema, duplicate ids, unknown depends_on, unsupported methods. Run it after editing YAML files. Returns {ok, errors:[{file,message}]}.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Read one endpoint definition by id (as shown by `list`). Returns the YAML text, its relative file and absolute path, so you can edit the file (for example to add tests).

tools.name: schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema of the YAML formats: `endpoint` for api/**/*.yaml files (request, tests, expect matchers, mock) or `config` for ajiro-api.yaml. Read it before writing or editing tests.

instructions: Ajiro API keeps one YAML file per HTTP endpoint (api/<resource>/<method>-<path>.yaml). Typical loop: 1) `scan` after changing routes (creates/updates endpoint files; it never touches `tests:` or `mock:`), 2) edit the YAML files to add or adjust `tests:` (use `schema` to see the format, `get_endpoint` to read one), 3) `validate`, 4) `test` against the running server and read each failure's `expected`/`actual` and `source` location, 5) fix the code (or the test if the behaviour change is intended) and repeat. `list` shows what is defined.
